visualCharacteristics.purpose: One-column list of documents: type icon (PDF / video), bold blue title link opening in a new tab, optional one-line ellipsis description; Resource Type filter and pagination built from the rows
visualCharacteristics.description: Same component and layout (single-column list, leading icon, linked bold title). The extra description line per item is an extra paragraph the block handles. Icon differs (fa-video here vs fa-file-pdf on 6000): the block should pick the icon per item or use one neutral document icon.

contentPattern.summary: 5 resource rows stacked full width: blue video icon, bold blue linked title, one-line grey description (ellipsis-truncated); Resource Type filter and pagination container / Filterable, paginated list of 3 gated-media documents, each a PDF icon + bold blue linked title / Filterable list of 5 documents: type icon (PDF / video), bold linked title, one-line truncated description; 'Filter by: Resource Type' dropdown above, pagination container below
contentPattern.structure: one row per document: (1) type cell: "pdf" or "video" (select field `type`); (2) rich text `text`: title link paragraph + optional description paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for product-page "Content and Resources" document lists. For a cover-image grid use cards-resource; for a two-column bordered download list use cards-downloads.
